inventory: Create ONE new transparent game UI icon for Godmist, a restrained mature dark fantasy pixel-art RPG. Subject: a compact closed worn dark-brown leather adventurer backpack with broad flap, two simple straps and aged brass buckles, immediately readable as inventory. Intended final native sprite size is only 32x32 pixels: use large coherent angular pixel clusters, dark charcoal outlines, chunky simple silhouette, few controlled warm ochre/brass and ivory highlights, subdued charcoal shadows. Slight three-quarter object view, centered isolated whole object, generous clean transparent margin on every side. It should occupy about 80 percent of the square source, no cut-off parts. Faithful old-school RPG inventory illustration rendered with deliberate hard pixel-like stepped edges, not cartoon, not vector, not modern flat UI, not realistic smooth gradients or noisy detailed painting. Warm muted brown/bronze palette matching worn leather, aged brass, charcoal-black Godmist UI and game inventory art. All shading belongs to the object, no glow, no sparkles. Real fully transparent RGBA background. No background tile, no decorative frame, no circle, no cast shadow, no text, no numerals, no letters, no logos, no watermark. This is a single standalone icon master to be reduced in Aseprite using premultiplied area-average sampling, hard alpha and at most 24 colors without dithering.
